The suspension was refluxed overnight to prepare Cd-loaded DWNTs.
Selenium powder was dispersed in distilled water by ultrasonication.
The resulting NaHSe solution was added dropwise to the prepared suspension of Cd-loaded DWNTs.
The suspension was refluxed for 3 h.
